mentions.title: The upgrades behind Red Bull’s breakthrough in Singapore
mentions.summary: Mark Hughes and Giorgio Piola identify how Red Bull's recent upgrades helped Max Verstappen clinch back-to-back wins in Malaysia and Singapore.

mentions.summary:
